children: Ingredion raised its quarterly cash dividend to 83 cents a share from 82 cents.
The new dividend will be payable on Oct. 20 to shareholders of record as of Oct. 1.
This is the twelfth consecutive year that Ingredion's board has approved a dividend increase in the third quarter.
The new payout, equal to $3.32 a year, represents an annual yield of 3.4% based on Thursday's closing price of $99.01.
